study type: Mechanistic (in vitro) study with a case-control component
cohort: The study utilized cells transfected with wild type/mutant CD69, miR-25 mimics/inhibitors, and samples from sepsis patients and normal control groups to investigate mechanisms relevant to neonatal sepsis.
finding: The single-nucleotide polymorphism (SNP; rs41274221) in miR-25 is associated with the risk of sepsis in newborns through its interaction with CD69 and regulation of interferon-γ production.
